transformation_chain_verbatim: The data were tokenized using the byte pair encoding algorithm.
We trained the tokenizer using nucleotide sequences and text from the wiki-103 dataset.
Subsequently, the nucleotide sequences and text annotations were partitioned into sentence-based chunks.
We included a special token < s > at the beginning and a special token < /s > at the end of the sequence.
The maximum length of the input sequence was set to 601 tokens.
